intro: {{nameA}} and {{nameB}} both offer {{course}} in Delhi, in our database opened in {{year}}. One is a one-year private programme, the other is a two-year public university school programme, so the fees are not for the same duration.
TERI University vs USLLS (GGSIPU) for LLM compares recorded fees and 2023 placements. The short labels in the page title are left as they are; the comparison below uses the usual short names.

sections.heading: TERI University vs USLLS GGSIPU for LLM: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose TERI School of Advanced Studies if you want a recorded one-year LLM total fee of ₹1,41,424, CLAT listed in our records, and a 2023 row with an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹20 lakh. Confirm the official fee and that the official report is for the LLM programme.

Choose USLLS at Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University if you want a public university school, recorded year tuition of ₹85,000 on two-year LLM specialisations, and a 2023 row with an average of ₹7 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh. Confirm the official IPU fee notice, which may include other payable heads besides this tuition figure.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: TERI University has a recorded Total Fees of ₹1,41,424 for a one-year Master of Law (LLM). Treat this as a recorded programme total, and confirm it on the official TERI SAS notice for the current year.

USLLS has recorded tuition of ₹85,000 a year on several two-year LLM specialisations, including corporate law, human rights, intellectual property, international / global legal studies, and ADR. This is a recorded tuition head, not a confirmed full annual payable fee. Check the official GGSIPU University School fee notice.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Both sides have a recorded 2023 average package of ₹7 lakh. TERI's recorded highest package is ₹20 lakh, listed against the one-year LLM. USLLS has a recorded highest of ₹12 lakh, listed against LLM International / Global Legal Studies.
These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise. Confirm each official report for the latest year.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: TERI University has CLAT listed in our records on this page. Confirm whether the current admissions cycle uses CLAT PG or a university test.

USLLS has no exam listed in our records here. Recent official GGSIPU counselling notices have used CLAT PG for LLM, so check the current IPU admissions notification rather than assuming a missing exam.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: TERI University is listed at Institutional Area, Vasant Kunj, Delhi. USLLS is listed at C-Block, Sector 16-C, Dwarka, on the GGSIPU campus.
Both are in Delhi, on different campuses. Visit if commute or the one-year versus two-year format will decide the choice.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: If you want a recorded one-year LLM with a 2023 highest package of ₹20 lakh and a recorded total fee of ₹1,41,424, TERI University is the side we can quote, after you confirm the official circular.

If you want a public university school and a two-year LLM, USLLS is the side we can quote, with recorded tuition of ₹85,000 a year and a 2023 average of ₹7 lakh. Confirm the full official IPU payable fee.
Do not compare the two fees as if they covered the same course length.

faqs.question: Which is better in 2026, TERI University or USLLS, for LLM?
faqs.answer: TERI has a recorded one-year total fee of ₹1,41,424 and 2023 figures of a ₹7 lakh average and a ₹20 lakh highest package. USLLS is a public university school with recorded year tuition of ₹85,000 on two-year LLMs, and 2023 figures of a ₹7 lakh average and a ₹12 lakh highest package. The durations differ.

faqs.question: Is the TERI LLM a one-year programme?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our records list it as a one-year LLM, and TERI SAS still lists a one-year LLM on its official programme pages. Confirm the current official brochure.

faqs.question: What fee is listed for USLLS?
faqs.answer: Our records list tuition of ₹85,000 a year for several two-year LLM specialisations. Confirm the official GGSIPU University School fee notice for other payable heads.

faqs.question: Do these programmes use CLAT PG?
faqs.answer: CLAT is listed for TERI University in our records. USLLS has no exam listed here, though recent official IPU counselling notices have used CLAT PG for LLM. Check the current notice.

faqs.question: How do 2023 placements compare?
faqs.answer: Both have a recorded average of ₹7 lakh in 2023. TERI has a recorded highest of ₹20 lakh; USLLS has a recorded highest of ₹12 lakh. Confirm the latest official reports.

faqs.question: Are both campuses in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Yes. TERI University is listed at Vasant Kunj. USLLS is listed at the GGSIPU Dwarka campus.
